**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "restrictive covenant" and "employees of the other Party", together with a full read of Section 12 (Customer Responsibilities) and Section 30.1, produced no responsive restriction.

To the contrary, § 12.3 (p0049) affirmatively protects us: it preserves our freedom to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" and records that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." Section 30.1 is a bare independent-contractor provision allocating responsibility for Vendor's personnel compensation and taxes — not a covenant.

This satisfies the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline was proposed and the fallback narrowing (mutual, service-personnel-only, 12 months, advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) is not needed.
